form.note: A third form family — employment tax rather than income tax — annotated with the same vocabulary. Its money boxes are split dollars/cents, which is what `layout.mode: "split"` exists for.
form.title: Form 941 — Employer's QUARTERLY Federal Tax Return

client.description: The employer's copy, with the EIN, bank details and designee PIN masked.

filing.description: The copy that goes to the IRS.
